_comment: Design guidance: Book 02, Chapter 09's migration path matrix and the implementation guide's Step 2 as reviewed data (Chapter 03). Rows are tried in order and the first match proposes the target; the owner's disposition (D-N3) decides. Learn's own tables (pinned in examples/third_party/entra-service-account-choice-pages) are the model for the on-premises and cloud choices; the rows add what they leave out. Change this file in a reviewed pull request; the run records its SHA-256 in its manifest.

outOfScope.ServicePrincipal: Governed through its app registration's row
outOfScope.ExternalServicePrincipal: Credentials and lifecycle are in the home tenant: review consent and permissions (Chapter 07)

Retire.label: Retire through the reviewed decommission process
Retire.rollback: Re-enable the account or service principal; restore within the recycle bin's 30 days

ManagedIdentity.label: Managed identity (user-assigned preferred)
ManagedIdentity.rollback: Re-enable the legacy account; revert the application's configuration to it

AppRegistrationFederated.label: App registration with a federated identity credential
AppRegistrationFederated.rollback: Re-enable the legacy account or credential; revert the application's configuration; remove the federated credential

AppRegistrationCertificate.label: App registration with a certificate credential
AppRegistrationCertificate.rollback: Re-enable the legacy account or secret; revert the application's configuration; remove the new certificate

gMSA.label: Group managed service account
gMSA.rollback: Re-enable the legacy account; set the service back to it

dMSA.label: Delegated managed service account (Windows Server 2025)
dMSA.rollback: Undo-ADServiceAccountMigration (Learn's undo for a dMSA migration); the superseded account is kept, never deleted

GmsaPlusAppRegistration.label: Keep the gMSA, plus an app registration for the cloud calls
GmsaPlusAppRegistration.rollback: Remove the app registration's credential; the gMSA is unchanged

KeepKerberos.label: Keep on Kerberos, islanded, with an SPN owner and an end date the authorizing official accepts

retireWhen: Chapter 02 found no owner (an orphan candidate not claimed and not excepted), or the account is disabled: the guide's 'disabled, unused, or no owner' row
